Issue Number: close #35553

Problem Summary: Incorrect total time summary log of backup ranges process
```
[2022/06/16 00:03:22.387 -04:00] [INFO] [client.go:567] ["Backup Ranges"] [take=67ns]
```

### What is changed and how it works?
Fix the code of printing the log. After fixed, it shows the correct time for backup ranges.
```
[2022/06/16 00:17:02.284 -04:00] [INFO] [client.go:538] ["Backup Ranges"] [take=595.572234ms]
```

issue_context.title: BR: incorrect total summary time for backup ranges
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
Run BR, it shows the incorrect total time for backup ranges.

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
Longer total summary time for backup ranges since the total summary time should at least include the backup range finished time.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
The total time for backup ranges is quicker than the time taken for finishing backup ranges.
```
[2022/06/16 00:03:22.387 -04:00] [INFO] [client.go:581] ["backup range finished"] [range
-sn=0] [take=682.314138ms]
[2022/06/16 00:03:22.387 -04:00] [INFO] [client.go:567] ["Backup Ranges"] [take=67ns]
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
Current master branch.

review_comments:
Good ~
Maybe we can print more information about `len(ranges)`.

Thanks! 
And yes, later I will have a follow-up pull request for modifying some printed log messages, which will also include the `len(ranges)` part.
